notes: Four new things: (1) Customize Dashboard - tap the tune icon on Home to show/hide and reorder sections. (2) The AI assistant now factors your Investments into net-worth-style answers (still manual, not live-synced). (3) AI Chat Language setting in Profile - Auto/English/Hindi/Hinglish. (4) A new "Log by voice" Quick Settings tile - swipe down, tap it, and speak an expense/task/habit without opening the app.
